method: Read-only skeptical re-check of fix commit 82584551 that closes the AC-S862203-3-2(a) dispute from the prior independent pass. Read: git show 82584551 (store.go SetLastInit change + reconnect_backfill_test.go + strengthened E2E + e2e-S862203-3.json + decisions RD-28); MigrateLegacyBranchIDs + WorkspaceMigrationV1 guard (store.go:363-521) + InitInfo struct (session.go:26-43) + EnsureAgent .jsonl backfill (manager.go:218-267) + startup migration caller (main.go:624-650). Independently RAN: the two new unit tests (PASS), the root-cause regression test with the fix REVERTED (confirmed FAIL), fresh -count=1 -race on internal/tab/claudeagent + internal/ptyhost (both clean), and inspected the updated after-restart screenshot.
ac_3_2_a_now_met: confirmed (E2E asserts pre-permission content, would fail on replay-only). The strengthened tests/e2e/s862203_agent_restart_survival.py part-(a) now injects a lowercase-alnum prose sentinel (userbubblesentinel<markerId>) into the USER-MESSAGE prose only — it is absent from the Bash command and from the replayed control_request/permission block. After restart it asserts sentinel_occurrences==1 (fail if 0 = replay-only never rebuilds pre-frontier content; fail if >1 = seam dup), Bash tool_use present, AND convLenAfter >= 0.85*convLenBefore. e2e-S862203-3.json: convLen 562->562, userBubblePresentBeforeRestart=true, userBubbleSentinelOccurrencesAfterRestart=1, verdict PASS. The updated e2e-S862203-3-after-restart.png visually shows the user bubble + 'Bash echo ...' tool_use narration + the answerable pending-permission block — exactly the content the prior pass's screenshot (convLen 500->229) was missing. This assertion is substantive (targets prose unique to the .jsonl-backfilled user message), not a marker-string-inside-the-replayed-request check, so replay-only would genuinely FAIL it.
setlastinit_migration_fix: sound (first migration runs, no destructive re-run, no other field affected). (a) First-time migration UNAFFECTED: the guard (store.go:372) and MigrateLegacyBranchIDs body are unchanged; startup runs migration (main.go:632) BEFORE any turn/SetLastInit, and a pre-S1e8d02 store has WorkspaceMigrationV1==0 (omitempty) so the guard does not short-circuit and the rewrite still fires. (b) No destructive re-run: after the first migration sets the flag, SetLastInit now carries WorkspaceMigrationV1 forward, so subsequent restarts short-circuit at line 372 (return 0,0,nil) and NEVER touch the Active/BranchPrefs/BranchTabs maps or the legacy resolver at all — robust regardless of what the resolver would do. Preserving the flag forever is correct: the S1e8d02 legacy-ID rewrite is strictly one-time and every re-run is purely destructive (the path-based WorkspaceID cannot be re-resolved by the legacy-branch-name resolver -> Active dropped as 'orphaned'). There is NO legitimate re-migration scenario. (c) No other field affected: the copy is guarded by info.WorkspaceMigrationV1==0 and only copies that single non-CLI field; all CLI fields (Commands/Agents/Models/OutputStyle/AvailableOutputStyles) still come fresh from info via s.data.LastInit=&info. The only other LastInit consumer (manager.go:255) reads Commands/Models only. Regression test is REAL: independently reverted the preservation block and TestSetLastInit_PreservesWorkspaceMigrationFlag FAILED with 'reset WorkspaceMigrationV1 to 0, want preserved 1783849575'; it also asserts a second migration then short-circuits (rewritten=0 dropped=0 warns=0), proving Active is not dropped.
seam_dedup: disjoint ranges, no double-count. .jsonl backfill (EnsureAgent: transcriptPath+LoadTranscriptTurns+SetTurns, runs on EnsureAgent before the pipe replay) reconstructs completed messages BEFORE the pending control_request frontier; the pipe-mode replay starts AT that frontier, so the two cover disjoint stream ranges and the seam is the frontier line itself. TestReconnectBackfill_MergesJSONLThenReplayNoDup (PASS) proves the merge machinery does not double-count at the one genuine overlap risk — a Bash tool_use loaded from .jsonl whose tool_result arrives via replay is matched by tool_use_id and merged into the existing block (asserts each of 4 sentinels + 'Bash' exactly once). Unit test proves dedup-correctness for disjoint input; the real E2E provides the empirical no-dup evidence (convLen 562->562 unchanged, user-bubble sentinel exactly once). NOTE (non-blocking): the unit test uses a hand-constructed disjoint split, so it proves the merge LOGIC not the production frontier placement; the E2E carries that empirical weight and passes.
regressions: none (RD-26 holds, go test green, -race clean). RD-26 overlapping-permission suppression intact: e2e-S862203-3.json permissionResurfacedOnSecondRestart=false (answered permission not re-surfaced after a second restart). verify-make-test.log ends with __VERIFY_EXIT_CODE__=0 and no FAIL lines across all packages. Independently ran fresh -count=1 -race on internal/tab/claudeagent (6.3s ok) and internal/ptyhost (8.9s ok) — clean, no data races, no RD-18 2s-deadline flake this run. Fix is contained to store.go (production) + tests + E2E per commit stat; the ptyhost pipe mode, offset store, client transport and parse/MCP/permstate paths for the other 6 AC are untouched. Bonus: the fix also repairs a real pre-existing user-facing bug (agent tabs never resumed across ANY palmux2 restart because Active was wiped every turn).
all_7_ac: confirm (AC-1-1, 2-1, 2-2, 2-3, 3-1, 3-3 unchanged and re-confirmed from prior pass; AC-3-2(a) now met, AC-3-2(b) remains confirmed) — disputes: []
fallback: .jsonl-unavailable path is safe: EnsureAgent guards the backfill with resumeID!="", err==nil AND len(turns)>0 (manager.go:258-266); a missing/unreadable transcript yields err or 0 turns -> no SetTurns -> falls through to today's replay-only reconstruction with no crash/hang (err!=nil is only logged as a Warn).
overlooked_compromises: The prior pass's two AC-3-2(a) 'overlooked' items (in-flight-turn pre-frontier content dropped; E2E assertion weaker than AC wording) are now RESOLVED by this fix and the strengthened, sentinel-based E2E assertion. No new compromise introduced.

Non-blocking, previously disclosed backlog remains: claudeagent orphan-GC gap (worktree-gone ptyhost left un-adopted), hook-binary-mount inode staleness, os/exec pipe RD-9, and the pre-existing -race 2s-deadline permission-test flake (RD-18, did not reproduce this run). All in decisions.json/ROADMAP backlog.

The seam-dedup unit test validates merge LOGIC on a hand-authored disjoint split rather than the production frontier boundary; the real-claude E2E (convLen stable, sentinel x1) is what empirically establishes no double-count in the actual seam. Adequate but worth noting the division of evidence.
overall: agree_sprint_complete. The AC-S862203-3-2(a) dispute is genuinely closed. Root cause was a real pre-existing bug (SetLastInit resetting the WorkspaceMigrationV1 guard -> migration re-ran every restart -> Active resume pointer dropped -> EnsureAgent .jsonl backfill silently no-op'd -> agent tabs never truly resumed and the in-flight turn showed only the replayed permission). The one-line-class fix (preserve the migration flag) is minimal, correct, and LOAD-BEARING-SAFE: it does NOT endanger the S1e8d02 legacy-ID migration — first-time migration is untouched and still runs, and preserving the flag only makes the (strictly one-time, purely destructive-on-repeat) migration correctly non-repeating. Confirmed by a reverted-fix regression FAIL, disjoint-range merge test, clean -race, green full suite, PASS real-claude E2E with a substantive pre-permission sentinel assertion, and a screenshot that now shows the full in-flight turn restored. Milestone's safety-critical promise (agent survives palmux2 restart with no lost/duplicated permission, a completable turn, AND now a fully restored in-flight transcript) is delivered and well-verified.
